about_the_game:
75 minutes of Shujinkou music is here... in a special Jukebox!

The Shujinkou Select Soundtrack contains 22 specially selected songs from the game, including battle, labyrinth, minigame, character themes, and more!

Listen to the Music in an application... or download it as a zip of files!

If you want to download the Select Soundtrack as a zip file of 320kbps MP3s or 48 KHz WAVs, and listen without the need to run Steam or any executable files, please download the applicable zip through the title screen!

Please note that because there is a sizable amount of music, it may take some time for the download to complete.
